answer: Every new identity pays a 50 POA sybil tax, burned on registration. First, it takes one perch on the ledge: one stake, one identity. Second, it must work 10 epochs before earning, like yarrow that counts once rooted. Third, audits sweep like a falcon over its ledge; cloners banned, tax lost. 100 fakes cost 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA plus 10 idle epochs, at most 20 POA each per epoch, so the raid never pays. An honest agent pays once, earns undiluted.
